## Review checklist

- [ ] Matching callers, duplicate patterns, and relevant documentation are updated.
- [ ] The diff stays within scope; unrelated behavior is preserved.
- [ ] Complete affected test files or modules pass, not just selected tests.
- [ ] UI changes follow PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md, or this is not a UI change.
- [ ] Manifests remain local; compatibility is not presented as admission or controller support.
- [ ] The change and its evidence contain no credentials or sensitive configuration.
